timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before the first suspension attempt

force_timeout.description: Additional seconds of inactivity before forced suspension (must be ≥ timeout)

action.description: Action to perform when suspension is triggered: 'suspend', 'hibernate', 'hybrid', or 'shutdown'

wakeup_action.description: Action to perform when system is woken up for maintenance: 'none', 'suspend', 'hibernate', or 'hybrid'

activity_log.description: Path to file where activity events are recorded

ignore_users.description: List of usernames whose activity should not reset the inactivity timer

ignore_processes.description: List of process names (exact match) whose activity should not reset the timer

ignore_devices.description: List of device paths (e.g., /dev/input/event*) whose activity should not reset the timer

activity_watch_paths.description: List of glob patterns for files or directories whose modification time counts as activity

suspend_on_battery_only.description: Whether to suspend only when running on battery power

battery_min_percent.description: Minimum battery percentage required for suspension on battery (set to 0 to disable)

ignore_network_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces whose activity (e.g., traffic, link up) should not reset the timer

pre_suspend_command.description: Command to run before suspension (e.g., sync or save state)

post_suspend_command.description: Command to run after resuming from suspension (e.g., restore state)

require_no_x11.description: Only suspend if no active X11 sessions are detected

require_no_wayland.description: Only suspend if no active Wayland sessions are detected

require_no_console_sessions.description: Only suspend if no active console sessions (loginctl) exist

require_no_ssh_sessions.description: Only suspend if no active SSH sessions exist

require_no_vnc_sessions.description: Only suspend if no active VNC sessions are detected

require_no_upnp_players.description: Only suspend if no active UPnP/DLNA media renderers are detected

require_no_printer_jobs.description: Only suspend if no pending print jobs exist

require_no_media_playback.description: Only suspend if no active media playback (MPRIS) is detected

require_no_file_transfers.description: Only suspend if no file transfers (rsync, cp, scp, etc.) are in progress

require_no_backups.description: Only suspend if no active backup processes (rsync, borg, restic, etc.) are running

require_no_database_services.description: Only suspend if no active database processes (e.g., postgres, mysql, mongodb) are detected

require_no_web_services.description: Only suspend if no web services (ports 80, 443, etc.) are listening

require_no_containers.description: Only suspend if no active containers (Docker, Podman, LXC, etc.) are running
